zh: 优化 AI 助手 Markdown 代码块渲染，支持多层嵌套及长代码围栏，避免技能内容被截断。
增强长文档与多重反引号块的解析稳定性，完整呈现大段代码与排版格式。
优化 DragonClaw 流式输出中的代码块展示与滚动交互体验。
en: Optimized Markdown code block rendering in AI assistant to properly keep nested and long fences in a single block without truncation.
Enhanced parsing stability for extensive documents and multi-backtick blocks to preserve intact formatting.
Refined DragonClaw streaming code display and scrolling interactions.
